wrong topic: environment awards (Indira Gandhi Paryavaran Puraskar)

patterns: APPSC asks definitional single-fact items: what circular economy is (reuse, recycling, repair), what green technology is not (not inexpensive for developing countries).
Typical shape is 'which is NOT correct/true about X' with three textbook traits and one false claim.
Greenwashing = false environmental claims is a recurring definition item across PSCs.
App goes much deeper into green finance instruments, EU Green Deal, BRSR and current schemes than PYQs ever do; keep them factual and direct.
